name: Mini vMac
description:
Mini vMac is a miniature emulator for early Apple Macintosh computers based on the Motorola 68000 microcomputer architecture. It emulates classic black-and-white Mac models including the Mac Plus, Mac 128K, 512K, and SE.

Features:
- Accurate 68000 CPU emulation running original System 6 and System 7 operating systems
- Faithful recreation of the vintage 512x342 monochrome Macintosh display
- Support for classic Mac floppy disk images (.dsk, .image) with drag-and-drop loading
- Emulation of classic Mac sound hardware, mouse, and keyboard
- Lightweight, fast, and portable design with minimal system requirements
